# The Golgotha Trench-Legions — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **ORDERS** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Chain of Command:** When an Officer activates it issues 1 Order (⟳) to a friendly unit within 12″ that has not activated: Take Aim! (+1 to Hit, cannot Move) · Forward! (may Shoot after its 2nd Move) · Dig In! (Cover and Braced) · Fire Mission! (an [INDIRECT FIRE] unit hits on 4+ against any enemy a Golgotha unit can see). Orders are priced on the Officers.

**Gamble — Danger-Close** *(risk: durability (friendly fire))*: When an [INDIRECT FIRE] unit targets an enemy unit within 6″ of a friendly Golgotha unit, it re-rolls Hit rolls; each unmodified Hit roll of 1 inflicts 1 Fatal Wound on the friendly Golgotha unit closest to the target.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Danger-Close* — Artillery re-rolls hits near friendlies.

## Detachment — Combined Arms Regiment

*The default: infantry hold, tanks and walkers punch.*

**Detachment rule:** Born Soldiers: Trooper units that issued no Order and received no Order this round get +1 to Hit with ranged weapons if they did not Move.

**Enhancements**
- **Grand Strategist** (+10 pts, Trench-Marshal): This Officer issues 2 Orders per round.
- **Relic Lasgun** (+10 pts, Trench-Marshal): The bearer's ranged weapon gets +1 Attack and +1 PEN.

**Stratagems**
- **Volley Fire** (1 CP) — *A Trooper unit is selected to Shoot:* Its rifles gain [HAILFIRE] at full range this activation.
- **Armoured Fist** (1 CP) — *A unit disembarks from a Transport:* It may Shoot this activation even after Rapid Disembark.
- **Fix Bayonets** (1 CP) — *A Trooper unit is charged:* Its retaliation strike gets +1 to Wound.

## Detachment — Siege Artillery Front

*Static gunline: mortars, Quake-Cannons and spotters grind the enemy into the mud.*

**Detachment rule:** Pre-Registered Fire: [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons get +1 to Wound against units within 6″ of an objective. Fire Mission! may be issued at 24″.

**Enhancements**
- **Master of Ordnance** (+10 pts, Trench-Marshal): Fire Mission! applies to 2 artillery units, and they re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
- **Vox-Relay Mast** (+10 pts, Trench-Marshal): The Order range is 24″.

**Stratagems**
- **Creeping Barrage** (2 CP) — *Start of the round:* Pick a 6″ zone. Enemy units ending a Move in it gain 1 Suppression token.
- **Danger Close** (1 CP) — *An [INDIRECT FIRE] unit targets an enemy engaged with friendlies:* Allowed; each natural 1 to hit hits the friendly unit instead.
- **Counter-Battery** (1 CP) — *An enemy [INDIRECT FIRE] unit shoots:* After it resolves, one friendly artillery unit may shoot it.

## Detachment — Grinder Brigade

*Horde: bodies on every objective, never give ground.*

**Detachment rule:** Endless Waves: once per round, when a Trench-Trooper unit is destroyed, set up a new 10-model unit of Trench-Troopers wholly within 6″ of your board edge (it counts as having activated). Max 2 per battle.

**Enhancements**
- **Iron Discipline** (+10 pts, Field Commissar): Friendly Troopers within 6″ ignore Rattled.
- **Banner of the Unbroken** (+10 pts, Trench-Marshal): The attached unit counts double CTRL while it has 5+ models.

**Stratagems**
- **Hold the Line** (1 CP) — *A Trooper unit on an objective is targeted:* It cannot become Pinned this round.
- **Over the Top** (1 CP) — *A Trooper unit activates:* It may Charge after a Move this activation.
- **Meat Shield** (1 CP) — *A friendly vehicle within 3″ of a Trooper unit is targeted:* The shooter must target the Troopers instead if they are visible.
